name: Boardroom Quarterly
tagline: Calm, high-density board and quarterly business review deck on white: KPI cards with deltas, SVG trend charts, conditionally coloured tables, RAG status and a risk register. Original slides-commons design.

palette.description: white canvas with slate neutrals, one calm corporate blue for the brand and the actual-data series, and semantic green / amber / red used only for status, favourable / unfavourable variances and the risk heat scale

typography.style: one clean grotesque family at 400-700 for everything, tight bold titles, uppercase tracked labels and tabular lining figures in every number

best_for: Board packs, quarterly and monthly business reviews, investor updates and operating reviews: KPI scorecards, actual-vs-plan trends, P&L variance tables, segment bullet charts, regional heatmaps, initiative RAG status, risk registers, outlook ranges and appendix metric tables.
avoid_for: Pitches, keynotes and storytelling decks with few numbers; creative or consumer audiences. The system expects real data on most slides and looks bare without it.
navigation: inline script (arrow keys, space, PgUp/PgDn, Home/End, mouse wheel, click, swipe)
